hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor... discovering a secret diary with whispers of romance.
voiceoverScript: whispers, "I was scrubbing the hearth when I found this paper tucked behind a mossy old book. It was her diary, and oh, how it stirred me! The scents of lavender and musk, the softness of her words, they spoke of secrets and desires, hidden in the shadows of our grand mansion. The ink was fresh, the inkling of her heart was bold, and the lines spoke of more than just scrubbing floors. It was then I knew, this is where my story begins.
caption:
Caught her in a moment of contemplation, secrets and romance revealed in her diary. Swipe up to see more of her hidden life! 💃
